title: Incorrect Usage
slide_intent: Teach designers to spot typographic choices that make a familiar message harder to read or recognize. Repeating the same phrase makes each deviation easier to isolate.
strategic_value: A compact set of counterexamples can protect Instacart’s hierarchy, face selection and tone across contributors.
demonstration: Two rows of examples vary the face, weight, color, case, effects and angle of an order-complete message, and include a body-copy misuse. Each has a red cross and short caption.
practical_value: Compare a proposed text treatment with the relevant example, then identify the specific attribute that needs correction.

content_islands.name: Misuse grid
content_islands.spec: Arrange eight examples in two rows of four on white. Reserve the upper-right cell for the body-copy example.

content_islands.name: Correction captions
content_islands.spec: Give each sample its own red cross and short contrasting label below. Keep the cause of the problem close to the type that demonstrates it.
